english.title: Continue to fail to comply with a remedial notice after conviction - A-s.B. Act 2003
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner or occupier of land, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), and having been convicted under section 75(9) of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003 of continued failure to comply with the requirements of a remedial notice under section 69 of the Act, failed without reasonable excuse to take steps which you had been ordered to take by section 75(7) of the Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(10) of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003.
